# Rename and Merge Checklist: Merge Check and Validate into Inspect

**Purpose**: Check the requirements for the agent merge, the rename and the advisor change
**Created**: 2026-10-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: standard. Audience: reviewer. Focus: agent contract, rename coverage, access (file write limits).

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is every place that names the phase, skill or agents listed, so FR-007 and FR-008 can be checked by search, not by memory? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the content of the merged report defined (findings with severity and location, coverage line, per-check verdicts, net verdict)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Is it defined which of the old analysis checks and validate checks the merged agent keeps, so none is lost in the merge? [Gap, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the release note text defined well enough to test (old names, new name, model file action)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is "only the `## Validate` section changed" testable, given that `git status` shows the file and not the section? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the line between "Check" as a phase name (renamed) and "check" as a plain word (kept) clear enough for a search to tell them apart? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "improvement" in the advisor step bounded (simpler approach, tasks to cut or merge), so it cannot widen the scope? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Does FR-002 (opus) agree with the model file template, which sets no entry for the Inspect agent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK009 Do SC-002 (tracked files outside `specs/`) and FR-007 use the same search scope? [Consistency]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK010 Is the mid-feature update covered (state.json says `check`, next phase is Build)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the recovery path for a blocked start covered (user renames `st-check` to `st-inspect` in the model file)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK012 Is SC-004 (planted gaps) tied to a repeatable sample, so the result does not depend on which feature is at hand? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Access

- [ ] CHK013 Is it stated that the merged agent gets Bash and Edit, which the old read-only check agent did not have, and that the write limit (FR-003) is the guard? [Access, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
